pages.title: Room-Temperature Superconductor
pages.text: A dark wafer through which current flows with zero resistance at ordinary temperatures. Electrons pair up into Cooper pairs and move through the lattice as one coherent wave. A magnet hovers over it, locked in place. Physicists have chased this for a century.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Hydrogen-rich compounds superconduct at high temperature, but only under crushing pressure. I let metallic hydrogen fill a metal-organic framework, doped it with an electride and seeded it with a condensate, so the cage held the pressure for me.
